mutations.contract: The page yields ENOUGH room, not just some: the whole DAG drawing ends up clear of the panel, never partly under it.
mutations.note: The discriminating witness for the 2026-09-16 review blocker. The shipped guard measured PARTIAL overlap against the drawing's SCROLLPORT (dag.right - max(dag.left, panel.right) >= reserve) and so was green over a diagram that was 100% covered: `#topopane` is 738px wide and only its left end was under the panel. This mutation shifts the page 300px SHORT -- the nav rail's own width, the obvious off-by-one -- which leaves the scrollport partly clear and the drawing wholly underneath. The old formula passes that; "the drawing's left edge is at or past the panel's right edge" does not. Its sibling `flyout-open-yields-the-page` mutates the same declaration to no shift at all, which is the pre-review build; this one is the near miss that looks correct. Re-sized 2026-10-20 (the_3d_pane_opens_in_the_mode_the_study_wants, review B1): the nav rail no longer stands down while the panel is open, it sits in flow between the panel and the DAG, so a 300px shortfall now puts the RAIL under the panel and the drawing stays clear -- the declared check went green over it. 600px is the same near miss one column further in: the rail's width plus the original 300px, which puts the drawing's left end back under the panel (witnessed at 1920 wide).
